name: ASUS Prime 750W Gold Fully Modular Black Power Supply AP-750G ATX 3.1 Ready
shortDescription: ASUS Prime 750W Gold Fully Modular Power Supply AP-750G - Black Edition (750 Watt / 80 PLUS Gold Certified / ATX 3.1 Ready & ATX 3.0 Compatible / Native PCIe 5.0 16-Pin 12VHPWR / 100% Fully Modular Cables / Dual Ball
descriptionHtml:
ASUS Prime 750W Gold Fully Modular Power Supply AP-750G - Black Edition (750 Watt / 80 PLUS Gold Certified / ATX 3.1 Ready & ATX 3.0 Compatible / Native PCIe 5.0 16-Pin 12VHPWR / 100% Fully Modular Cables / Dual Ball Bearing Cooling Fan)

Deliver reliable and high-efficiency energy to your high-end gaming PC with the ASUS Prime 750W Gold Fully Modular Power Supply (AP-750G) in Black, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Built with 80 PLUS Gold efficiency and complete ATX 3.1 Ready standard support, this fully modular black PSU includes a native PCIe 5.0 12VHPWR 16-pin cable to safely power modern and next-generation graphics cards. The fully modular design ensures optimal cable management and airflow, while the 135mm dual ball bearing fan delivers durable and quiet cooling performance.
